in_hebrew.name: יהודיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Hebrew words יהוה (YHWH, Jehovah) and יד (yad, hand). It signifies 'Jehovah's right hand,' indicating strength, power, and protection from God.

in_greek.name: Ιαμετινος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name Jamieson is Ιαμετινος (Iametinos). However, it is important to note that there is no direct biblical Greek equivalent for this name as it is of English origin. This name has been adopted in the Greek language in modern times.

in_latin.name: Iamason
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Jamieson is Iamason. This name has been derived from the English name Jamieson, which is a combination of 'Jamie' (supplanting the original 'James') and the Scottish suffix '-son' (meaning 'son of').
